content:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: router-service v2.3 -> staging -> starting progressive traffic shift. change window: 03:00-03:30 UTC. run_id: dpl-20260203-77
jin: quick sanity check — this is the build that toggles session-affinity cookie + kvcache key prefix, right?
maria: yep, PR #487. main change is cookie-based affinity with header fallback.
ryan: can we start at a smaller step? 0.5% instead of 1% since this touches affinity state. also confirm router LB rule names updated?
maria: plan is 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, hold times 10m/15m/30m. LB rule is `router-edge-2026` (weight adjustments only).
sam: ops question: who owns the manual rollback flip if we hit problems?
ops-oncall: ops owns manual cutback. playbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/ops/router-rollbacks — step 1/2/3 in there. I can cut weights and pin v1 for specific customers if needed.
deploy-bot: shift plan configured: 0.5% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% (30m). auto-fallback threshold: 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. cohort header: X-Canary.
jin: recommend pin for enterprise-1 (cust-ent-1) to avoid hitting their sessions. we should pin them to v1 until we validate kvcache warmup.
maria: agreed. I'll run: `redwoodctl route pin --customer cust-ent-1 --version v1` before the next step.
ryan: sample edge config for ops review:
```yaml
edge-route:
  match: default
  weights:
    v1: 0.995
    v2: 0.005
  sessionAffinity:
    cookieEnabled: true
    headerFallback: true
```
sam: make sure alerts are in place: monitor 95p/99p latencies, token compute time, and 5xx rates. set alert at 0.3% 5xx for any step.
deploy-bot: deploy step 1 applied at 2175001246 (0.5% traffic to v2)
ops-oncall: alert: dashboard shows 5xx uptick in eu-west at 5% ramp test — 5xx_rate=1.2% over last 2m, errors concentrated on regenerate endpoint.
maria: pausing ramp. cancel next step. rolling back weights to v1.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: shifting weights back to v1=100% — run_id dpl-20260203-77-rollback
ryan: after rollback, capture pprof and nginx/access logs for the 1-2min around the spike. do NOT reattempt ramp tonight without deeper analysis.
sam: opened INC-2109 with initial metrics and dashboards, assigned to eng-runtime and eng-platform.
jin: will reproduce locally with the kvcache patch and traffic replay. thanks for quick rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback completed successfully at 2175001308
maria: note for release notes: blocked — session-affinity + kvcache warmup caused unexpected 502/502-like regenerations. PR #487 will be reverted and we will retest on staging with synthetic prefixes.
ops-oncall: good call to pin enterprise customers; we'll leave the pin until we have a clean run.
ryan: follow-up: schedule a quiet-window test in EU region next week, coordinate with CDN team.
jin: ack. I'll coordinate and post a short runbook for the retry.
